summary: Phase 3.1 — Array Bindings backend tested end-to-end. 13/13 functional tests pass once CoinGecko rate-limit cooldown is honoured (10 passed in a single run + the remaining 3 array-test-api CoinGecko cases pass in isolation after a 70s sleep). Reddit nested-array case is upstream Cloudflare-blocked from this server IP (502) — documented in spec as expected → test soft-skips. Frontend smoke skipped after login automation hit the same landing-page SIGN-IN gate noted in iter48 (loop-prevention triggered after 2 attempts). All Phase 3.1 data-testids confirmed present in ApiSourceTab.jsx source. Main agent already smoke-tested live.

minor.issue: Return status 200 (default) instead of 201 for resource creation. Spec/PRD describes 201. Cosmetic — frontend doesn't depend on it.

Provider per-minute burst (60/min) is easy to hit when running the full Phase 3.1 suite back-to-back; subsequent CoinGecko tests skip with 429/502. Same fixed-minute window issue from iter48 unchanged.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Return 201 from POST /api/admin/widgets and /api/admin/widgets/from-template/{tk} for REST hygiene.

OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='admin-widget-edit-{key}' on the pencil icons in the widget manager list to enable reliable Playwright opening of the builder. Currently selectors collapse to ambiguous icon buttons.

FYI: Reddit subreddit_top from this preview egress IP returns Cloudflare 502 — not a code bug, but the proxy correctly forwards it as 502 (per Phase 3 minor note, ideally 429/5xx forwarded verbatim). Phase 3.1 tests soft-skip this case as documented in the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: services/api_widget_proxy._apply_array_bindings: correctly distinguishes scalar-mode (item_map={'_':'path'}) → list of scalars vs object-mode → list of dicts. max_items clamped 1..100. Non-list array_path resolves to []. Robust.
services/api_widget_proxy.get_path: correctly handles root-level array (array_path='') by returning the whole obj; works for CoinGecko markets. Also tolerates dotted paths and bracket indices.

routers/api_widgets: array_bindings flows through both test-api (stealth-only) and widgets/api-call (registry path), preserving Phase 3 single-value response_map alongside (both 'mapped' and 'mapped_arrays' returned).

routers/admin_widgets._validate_editor_config validates array_bindings shape (list, dict items, field_key required, item_map dict) and returns 400 on violation. Confirmed all 3 invalid shapes return 400.

core/widget_templates: live_crypto_markets / live_news_headlines / live_reddit_top all carry array_bindings preset in editor_config.data_source — verified end-to-end (from-template → registry → /widgets/api-call returns 10 mapped items for live_crypto_markets, second call returns cached=true).
Renderer integration (CustomWidgetRenderer.jsx) merges mapped + mapped_arrays into editor_config.data; MediaGridLayout accepts both string-array and object-array shapes (source confirmed).

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 functional tests; Reddit case soft-skip is upstream Cloudflare block, not code bug)
success_rate.frontend: not_tested (login automation gated by landing-page SIGN-IN flow; selectors collapse on widget-list pencil icons — same blocker as iter48)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned (via module teardown): TEST_ widgets for editor_config validation (4 attempts; only the valid one persisted then deleted), t_live_crypto_markets_* / t_live_news_headlines_* / t_live_reddit_top_* drafts (deleted), crypto_mk_* draft launched + deleted, crypto_single_* draft + deleted. A handful of widgets from earlier failed runs (e.g. t_live_crypto_markets_4bc054) remain in the registry — not auto-cleaned because they were created before the autouse cleanup fixture saw their ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_widget_api_phase31_array.py. If CoinGecko cases skip with 429/502, wait 70s and re-run TestArrayBindingsTestApi in isolation. Reddit case will likely always skip from this preview IP (Cloudflare block). For frontend smoke, the @stealth login form needs you to click SIGN IN on the marketing landing first, then fill /login form fields — direct goto('/admin/widgets') redirects through that flow. Pencil-icon selectors on widget list are ambiguous — main agent should add per-widget data-testid for reliable Playwright editing access.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Two minor design observations carried from iter48 still apply (fixed-minute rate buckets, 502 masking of upstream 429). New cosmetic note: POST creation endpoints return 200, not 201.
